detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

MGF (Mechano Growth Factor)

Chemical Information:
  • Compound Type: Synthetic peptide research compound
  • Peptide Class: IGF-1 splice variant–derived peptide
  • Peptide Length: Short-chain peptide (isoform-derived) (Note: MGF represents a truncated peptide sequence derived from an alternative splice variant of the IGF-1 gene.)
  • Form: Lyophilized solid
Molecular Structure:

Note: MGF is a splice-variant–derived peptide sequence associated with the IGF-1 gene family. Due to isoform variability and synthesis-specific design, a single fixed molecular structure is not universally applicable.

Product Description:

MGF (Mechano Growth Factor) is a synthetic peptide consisting of a defined amino acid sequence. It is produced via peptide synthesis and supplied as a lyophilized powder for laboratory use.

This product is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro research applications conducted by qualified professionals. It is not formulated for clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro investigation of short IGF-related peptide fragments in biochemical assay systems
  • Structural and analytical evaluation of splice variant–derived peptide sequences
  • Stability and degradation studies of synthetic IGF-family peptide analogs
  • Analytical method development involving short-chain regulatory peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Handle using appropriate aseptic laboratory techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory buffers
Compliance Notice:

MGF is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
